method: Visual inspection of both initial orientations for all three fighters and four representative movement/released-idle captures from actual native FightEngine.
findings: All three source silhouettes remain complete in both initial orientations, with no visible clipping, placeholder or portrait substitution.
Tremer remains grounded; Wood Sapling keeps all branch-like limbs visible and its calibrated base on the existing floor. Their small presentation sizes follow unchanged source profiles.

Remnant retains the complete suspended cage and baked human-shaped ground silhouette in both orientations and through sampled movement. No clearly detached second shadow is distinguishable at this capture scale.
Movement and release samples preserve the same static idle bitmap. All six technical cases use the original input callbacks without actor-state injection.
limitations: Native Canvas only; Chromium, DOM/CSS, HTTP, browser keyboard delivery and service workers are outside scope.
These are single-frame static idle candidates. No walk animation, attack, contact, guard, finisher, original timing or 1:1 fidelity is certified.
Remnant shadowScaleProposal:0 is not supported by the current calibration/rendering schema. Existing default runtime ellipse remains; no renderer or calibration change was made.
Visual review samples ten of the twenty-one saved images. Every capture and source asset is retained and hashed in the technical report.
